notes.title: Small update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Just writing some brief notes to let you know that I've uploaded a new build of Salome that fixes a handful of typos present in the English script.

Hopefully, the reading experience should be smoother and more pleasant now.

As always, let me know if you encounter more typos, or any bugs, and I'll try to fix them when I can!

- ebi x

notes.title: Small update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

I'm just writing a quick post to let you know I've uploaded an update for [i]Salome's Kiss[/i]. This new build fixes a few minor typos which were scattered throughout the story, and a few incorrect line breaks which were making the text display incorrectly in a handful of instances.

This update is pretty minor (nothing of any great import was changed), but hopefully it makes the [i]Salome's Kiss[/i] readng experience even smoother!

As always, do let me know if you find more typos, or any other misc issues, and I will fix them whenever I have the time!

- ebi x
